_README: Hospital machine-readable standard-charge files read for data/private-rates.json. Each entry is one file a hospital publishes under 45 CFR 180.50, found through the cms-hpt.txt file at the hospital's own domain (45 CFR 180.50(d)(6)). Download each mrfUrl to <raw dir>/<file>, then run scripts/payer/extract_hpt.py and scripts/payer/build_private_rates.py. The sha256 of every downloaded file is recorded in data/private-rates.json; a file whose bytes differ is a different file.
